name: Cyclorama
summary: Framer component that maps image slides onto the inside of a cylinder you drag or scroll through, like a 360° room.
description: A Framer component that places image panels on the inner surface of a cylinder around the camera, so moving through the gallery reads as turning your head inside a 360° room rather than spinning an object. Drag or scroll changes the bearing; six presets, two layouts, four indicators and seven cursor styles are set from an in-canvas control panel, and a guide page walks through setup, every control, interaction, access and performance.
contains: Framer component dragged in from the assets panel
slides mapped onto the inner surface of a cylinder
eight to sixteen image panels with optional captions
six presets, two layouts, four indicators, seven cursor styles
drag or scroll to navigate, with bearing readout
